description: Episode-level opt-in for ASR-driven source trimming (measured edit constraints)
rationale: Trim head/tail wait frames while preserving complete dialogue. Only trim units with PASS dialogue_qa and non-empty ASR segments; a non-PASS unit whose word-timed ASR recalls every line is trimmed at the tail only (last word end + trail). Units without dialogue fall back to full-length. trail_seconds 0.4 = s7_edit_invariants.SENTENCE_TAIL_SECONDS (device 1101 E24 2026-11-23: lines spilled across cuts).
deployment_coordination: nalu: every episode of every series (deep review 1485 E09, 2026-11-23: the gate 'E11+' was written when the line ran one series whose E01-E10 were already delivered; on the fleet every new series starts at E01, so E01-E10 of every device's series shipped without the measured edit -- lines spilled across cuts on JA E09). qingshan keeps its E65 gate.
